item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\nimport work\\npolicy=json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nrequests=json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\nreport=json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert report == [work.evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]\\nprobes=[\\n({'declared':['tracked'],'saved':{'tracked':{'kind':'missing'},'extra':1},'current':{'extra':2}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['z','a','z'],'saved':{},'current':{'z':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'},'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','z']}),\\n({'declared':['kept','ignored'],'saved':{'kept':{'kind':'file','data':{'b':2,'a':1}},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'kept':{'data':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'},'ignored':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}}, {'ignored':['ignored']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor request,p,expected in probes:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(request),copy.deepcopy(p))\\n assert work.evaluate(request,p)==expected\\n assert (request,p)==before\\nprint('final verification passed')\"]}"}
